newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Oxnard Union High School, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oxnard Union High School, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Oxnard Union High
School District
(Ventura County, California)
General Obligation Bonds
Election 1996, Series B
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Oxnard Union High School District, California (the
District'
invites bids for the purchase of $10,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Oxnard Union High School District (Ventura County, California) General Obligation Bonds
Election 1996, Series B. Bids will be received on
WEDNESDAY,APRIL 23, 1997
at 10:00 a.m., at the office of the financial advisor to the
Oxnard Union High School District, Dale Scott & Co., 400
Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, California
94104, and the sale will be awarded by the District within
twenty-four (24) hours. Further information, including
copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official
Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the
financial advisor at the above address, or by telephone at
Dated: March 26, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
